title: A user can read another account
summary: An authenticated user can fetch records owned by another account.
rootCause: The query filters by record ID without checking the owner.

steps: Log in as a regular user, request another account record, and receive its contents.

severity.rationale: Cross-account private record disclosure has substantial confidentiality impact.

confidence.rationale: Source traces the request to an unscoped lookup.

remediation.summary: Scope every record lookup to the authenticated account.
regressionTests: Reject a request for another account record.
